alt: 孩子退後欣賞自己完成的木製模型橋，雙手叉腰，臉上露出自信而滿足的微笑，橋上小車安穩通過。
scene_prompt: 躊躇滿志 means a satisfied, self-confident feeling of accomplishment after success. A modern school woodworking/model-making club, one older child stands beside a beautifully completed small wooden model bridge on a worktable. The bridge is visibly finished, neat and stable, with a small plain wooden toy car crossing on it. The young maker has set down their tools, stands back with hands naturally on their hips, head slightly raised, proud contented smile, admiring their own successful work. Nearby lie a few simple earlier cardboard practice models, a ruler without markings and pencil, showing effort completed, not arrogance toward others. Warm quiet moment of fulfillment. Only ONE child; anatomically accurate limbs, both hands attached naturally to hips, two legs and grounded feet; stable bridge supports and car wheels correctly positioned. No text, numerals, lettering, diagrams with writing, logos or speech bubbles.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
